label: sparse, diffuse: copy-phase token combos (in w/y/g/1, out l/g/w/q/n) plus last original token of length-9 sequences
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.07% of steps), weak activations (median 0.12 of max 0.28). About 74% of activation mass is in the copy phase, enriched for inputs w/y/g/1 and outputs l/g/w/q/n, but every token conjunction has precision of 3-9%. The strongest activations come on the final original token (orig_idx 8) of length-9 sequences, often ones starting with q or n, yet that fires on only about 1% of such steps. Never fires at t<6 or when the copy has gone wrong. No predicate tried got F1 above 0.08, so the trigger looks like a hidden-state combination that these variables do not capture.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: in_tok=w (+4.27), phase=2 & in_tok=g (+3.72), phase=2 & in_tok=q (+3.23), in_tok=z (+2.68), out_tok=g (+2.66), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+2.60). Lower it: next_out=v (-3.63), next_out=j (-3.18), orig4=h (-2.67), prev_tok=u (-2.51).
